nodes.name: contract-form.tsx

nodes.name: ContractFields

nodes.name: ContractDialog

nodes.name: DeleteContractButton

nodes.name: debt-payment-form.tsx

nodes.name: AddDebtDialog
nodes.summary: Exported dialog for creating a new debt (creditor, amount, interest, schedule) via the createDebt server action.

nodes.name: EditDebtDialog
nodes.summary: Exported dialog for editing an existing debt via the updateDebt server action.

nodes.name: DeleteDebtButton
nodes.summary: Exported button + confirmation dialog that deletes a debt via the deleteDebt server action.

nodes.name: DebtPaymentDialog
nodes.summary: Exported dialog for recording a payment against a debt via the recordPayment server action.

nodes.name: SettleDebtButton
nodes.summary: Exported button + confirmation dialog that fully settles a debt in one payment.

nodes.name: goal-form.tsx
nodes.summary: Client form dialogs for savings goals: create/edit/delete a goal and record a payment toward it.

nodes.name: GoalFields
nodes.summary: Shared form fields for a savings goal (name, target amount, priority, deadline) reused by add and edit dialogs.

nodes.name: GoalDialog
nodes.summary: Shared dialog wrapper handling create/edit submission for a savings goal.

nodes.name: GoalPaymentDialog
nodes.summary: Exported dialog for recording a payment toward a savings goal via the addGoalPayment server action.

nodes.name: DeleteGoalButton
nodes.summary: Exported button + confirmation dialog that deletes a savings goal via the deleteGoal server action.

nodes.name: transaction-csv.tsx
nodes.summary: Client components and parsers for importing/exporting bank transactions as CSV: detects bank export formats (Sparkasse etc.), parses rows, and drives an export/import dialog flow.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a small hand-rolled CSV parser and per-bank column mapping instead of a library, plus German decimal-format amount parsing.

nodes.name: decodeCsv
nodes.summary: Decodes a raw CSV file buffer into text, handling byte-order-mark and encoding detection.

nodes.name: parseCSV
nodes.summary: Splits raw CSV text into header and row arrays, handling quoted fields and delimiters.

nodes.name: detectFormat
nodes.summary: Detects which bank/export format a CSV file matches based on its header columns.

nodes.name: formatLabel
nodes.summary: Returns a human-readable label for a detected CSV bank format.

nodes.name: mapRows
nodes.summary: Maps raw CSV rows into transaction objects according to the detected bank format, converting amounts and dates.

nodes.name: ExportTransactionsButton
nodes.summary: Exported button that triggers a CSV export of transactions for an account.

nodes.name: ImportTransactionsDialog
nodes.summary: Exported dialog that lets the user upload a bank CSV file, preview detected/mapped transactions, and import them.

nodes.name: transaction-form.tsx
nodes.summary: Client form dialogs for creating, editing, categorizing, and deleting individual financial transactions.

nodes.name: txFormReducer
nodes.summary: Reducer managing local transaction-form state (type, amounts, accounts, category) as fields change.

nodes.name: AddTransactionDialog
nodes.summary: Exported dialog for creating a new transaction via the createTransaction server action.

nodes.name: EditTransactionDialog
nodes.summary: Exported dialog for editing an existing transaction via the updateTransaction server action.

nodes.name: TransactionCategorySelect
nodes.summary: Exported inline category selector for a transaction row that updates the category via updateTransactionCategory.

nodes.name: DeleteTransactionButton
nodes.summary: Exported button + confirmation dialog that deletes a transaction via the deleteTransaction server action.

nodes.name: InventoryClient
nodes.summary: Exported root client component managing the filtered/selected state for the inventory grid and opening the detail sheet.

nodes.name: Karte

nodes.name: Detail

nodes.name: Zeile
nodes.summary: Small labeled key/value row used inside the detail view.

nodes.name: Marke
nodes.summary: Small badge/marker component showing an on/off icon indicator with a label.

nodes.name: Chip

nodes.name: LeereVitrine
nodes.summary: Empty-state component shown when the inventory has no items (or none match the filter).

nodes.name: ValuableActions

nodes.name: ValuableForm.tsx

nodes.name: ValuableForm
nodes.summary: Exported dialog form for creating/editing a valuable, submitting via createValuable/updateValuable server actions.

nodes.name: Feld
nodes.summary: Reusable labeled text/number input field used throughout the valuable form.

nodes.name: Haken
nodes.summary: Reusable labeled checkbox field used in the valuable form.

nodes.name: ValuableIcon.tsx
nodes.summary: Maps a valuable category to a representative icon inside a styled frame, for use in cards and lists.

nodes.name: Frame

nodes.name: ValuableIcon
